title: Bound actual nonlinear viscous shear growth by a nilpotent four-group H3 hierarchy
statement: With e1=a/|a|,e2=p/|p|,e3=e1 cross e2 and Di=e_i.grad, [D1,A]=[D3,A]=0 for A=P[(a cos(2pi p.x).grad) dot]. A D2 commutator reduces the number of D2 derivatives, never raising total order beyond3. Multinomial weights c_alpha=choose(3,|alpha|)*|alpha|!/(alpha1!alpha2!alpha3!) split EXACT H3 energy into four groups E_j by alpha2=j; ||u||H3<=E=sum E_j<=2||u||H3. Viscosity dissipates in each group and differentiated nonlinear leading transport cancels. The energy pairing of the remaining (1,3),(2,2),(3,1) commutators is bounded by C0||D^alpha u||2||u||H3^2,C0=2^20, with explicit lattice/convolution bounds including second-derivative products. Thus E_j_prime<=gamma*h*sum_(i<j)E_i+delta*C0*E^2, gamma=2^20*s*A*(1+P1)^3. The 4x4 strictly lower triangular majorant J has J^4=0, so its exponential terminates at degree3. L=(1+2^24*s*A*(1+P1)^3)^3 gives E<=L*(2K+4delta*C0*integral E^2). For delta<=1/(32C0L^2K), actual nonlinear pulse H3<=4LK and inviscid linear H3<=2LK. This is a polynomial physical nonlinear continuation tool, not merely a linear estimate.
